evidence_status: pre-execution design; contains no measured calibration result

coordinate_system.origin: surveyed centre of the six receive phase centres
coordinate_system.angular_order: ANT1 is forward; ANT2 through ANT6 proceed clockwise

assumptions_requiring_physical_confirmat: 51 mm is the RF phase-centre circle diameter, not only a mechanical outline
TX1 RF phase centre is coincident with the circle centre
all seven phase centres have recorded height and polarization
feed cables are identified, immobilized and included in the chosen calibration plane

wavelength_rows.center_regime: radiating near field / Fresnel by the 51 mm aperture heuristic
reactive near field by the 51 mm aperture heuristic

frequency_plan.interpretation: The 51 mm circle is geometry-relevant at 5.8 GHz, but exact 5.800 GHz remains an explicit experimental condition outside the official AD9363 range. Begin qualification in the established 2.4 GHz band.

schedule.transition_contract: Every selected-to-selected transition passes through ALL_OFF; ANT7 and ANT8 are never selected.

rx_gain_qualification.selection_stage: bounded low-power qualification before the calibration matrix
rx_gain_qualification.selection_rule: Increase only as needed to pass per-port SNR and selected-to-null contrast while retaining all declared headroom gates; persist the exact selected value before admitting calibration artifacts.
rx_gain_qualification.lock_scope: Never change gain within an artifact. Reuse the predeclared selected value for all three repeats of a frequency/condition; prefer one global value for the complete matrix when it passes every condition.

capture_plan.state_alignment: Detect the long ALL_OFF marker, then label the six fixed-order active intervals by ordinal. Reject a missing marker, guard, edge or state instead of guessing.
capture_plan.ordering_rationale: Forward, reverse and rotated frequency orders expose time drift and 5.8 GHz transition effects instead of confounding them with one schedule position.

pcb_route_priors.interpretation: Released realized copper and a cross-section model are diagnostic priors, not measured cable/switch calibration.

calibration_model.electrical_factor: C_i contains cable, connector, PCB route and switch response
calibration_model.ota_factor: A_i contains element response, mutual coupling and the local electromagnetic environment
calibration_model.identifiability: A single centered OTA measurement identifies only the product C_i*A_i; multiplying C_i by any nonzero complex q_i and dividing A_i by q_i leaves H_i unchanged.
calibration_model.reference_transfer: When a stable RX1 reference is present, form RX2/RX1 before local ALL_OFF subtraction.
calibration_model.normalization: Use a circular phase centre and geometric-mean amplitude; do not privilege ANT1 as the stored calibration gauge.
calibration_model.spatial_modes: M_m = (1/6) * sum_n h_n * exp(-j*2*pi*m*n/6); an ideal centered C6 response contains only M_0.
separation_experiment: Measure a characterized conductive splitter/through standard at the six board SMA planes.
Repeat at the array feed ends to include the cables.
Rotate characterized splitter outputs or cyclically permute element-to-port assignments.
Fit a complex port/element two-factor model and reject separability when its residual gate fails.
calibration_model.scope_limit: Center equalization is not a general direction-of-arrival manifold; directional use requires surveyed off-centre or angular calibration positions.

timing_and_gpio_qualification.status_at_design_update: No logic analyzer is physically connected; choose and record one evidence path before calibration-data admission.

preferred_path.name: independent_logic_analyzer_gpio
preferred_path.method: With RF muted, independently observe the selector GPIO and timing reference while exercising boot, reset and the complete repeating frame.
qualifies: GPIO code identity for ALL_OFF and ANT1 through ANT6
active-state order and absence of illegal GPIO codes
marker, guard, dwell and cycle timing
break-before-make transitions and boot/reset return to ALL_OFF

fallback_path.name: source_readback_hash_plus_low_power_rf_timing
fallback_path.prerequisites: Pass host state-machine/profile/ELF tests, bind the exact profile and firmware hashes, flash the exact target, and verify the flashed/readback image hash before a bounded low-power RF timing smoke capture.
fallback_path.independently_observed: Selected/null RF edges may independently qualify marker, guard, dwell and cycle timing only when edge contrast and continuity gates pass.
fallback_path.not_independently_observed: GPIO code identity, active-port identity/order and absence of illegal GPIO codes remain source-derived and flashed/readback-hash-backed; they are not independently GPIO-observed and must be labelled exactly that way in the report.
fallback_path.prohibition: Do not describe RF-only timing evidence as independent GPIO-code or port-identity observation. A centered equal-amplitude source cannot prove which antenna code produced an active dwell.

timing_and_gpio_qualification.gate_policy: Code identity, ANT1-through-ANT6 order, zero illegal codes, break-before-make and timing gates remain unchanged. The selected evidence path changes only the evidence label, not the claim or threshold.

safety_and_recovery.initial_tx_state: both TX channels muted and read back
safety_and_recovery.gain_policy: Use manual gain selected in bounded low-power pre-matrix qualification, starting at the lowest conservative supported hardware gain. Never change it within an artifact; reuse the predeclared value across repeats of each frequency/condition and prefer one global matrix value when feasible. AGC is forbidden.
safety_and_recovery.power_ramp: begin at the smallest bounded TX stimulus and increase only while all headroom gates pass
safety_and_recovery.condition_cleanup: mute and read back the exact Pluto serial after every condition and once independently at the end
safety_and_recovery.enodata_policy: On buffer.refill ENODATA, accept no artifact, splice no partial IQ, mute/read back, preserve the failed attempt, and retry the unchanged plan item with a new artifact identity.
safety_and_recovery.rollback: Keep the qualified Fast20 and safe-hold images available; any timing, GPIO, watchdog or readback failure returns the selector to ALL_OFF and blocks RF acquisition.

source_documents.role: RF cross-section, operating ceiling and switch settling
RF topology, reference planes and first-article acceptance
qualified capture continuity and phase-analysis boundary
evidence that the predecessor implementation uses a 1 ms timing base
